objective: Train D (degree-normalized scale-free memory, mixed patterns), Dr (same reads, rand only) and Dn (degree-normalized, no memory, mixed patterns) by OpenAI-ES, two seeds each; test with five runs per instance against widely re-tuned Novelty+ and probSAT on held-out local and on the training families.
status: Degree-normalized, step-free memory carries the navigating agent to held-out meeting patterns: R vs two-stage-tuned Novelty+ (five runs) 0.83 [0.63, 1.09] on local window 10 at 3200 (primary; old agent 24.7), 0.66 at 800, 0.72-0.81 on heavy, 0.95 on window 160, 0.75 on window 40 (one seed of four at 2.99); flips wins on local 800, heavy 3200, block 3200; loses on rand 2.1 at 3200 (1.60); the reads do the carrying (Dr/L3sm = 0.031, D/Dr = 1.09); 1.5-9x CPU, no CPU win. Inner-loop bar: D usable on the primary only by the frozen rule (window 40 seed); Dr meets it everywhere held out. Computed, referee pending.
title: Degree-normalized scale-free memory trained on mixed meeting patterns, tested on a held-out one
